player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a Haɗa Hudu. Alamar faifan ku: {symbol}. Kwamitin wasan yana da layuka {num_rows} da ginshiƙai {num_cols}. 'Yan wasa suna juyawa suna sauke faifan su a cikin ɗayan ginshiƙai (0 zuwa {end_col}). Na farko da ya haɗa (na kansu) faifai huɗu a tsaye, a kwance, ko a kwance ya ci nasara. A lokacin da kuka juya, shigar da lambar shafi a cikin ƙuƙwalwar ƙira don yin motsin ku. Misali: '[col 4]' ko '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ba a iya ganin allon wasan ga 'yan wasa.
